title: Pricing Velocity & Release Surge Mapping for Model Providers
creator: Ariana Patel
description:
Background: customers and Sales increasingly cite surprise price changes and unexpected model feature releases (e.g., new quantized variants, expanded context lengths, tool-calling upgrades) as risk factors when choosing inference providers. We lack a systematic signal set that quantifies the velocity of price/feature changes across providers and ties these events to potential cost/compatibility impact for Redwood customers.

Objective: build an ongoing pipeline and dashboard that maps two orthogonal signals: (1) Pricing Velocity (rapid changes in published token/endpoint pricing, tier changes, or credit programs) and (2) Release Surge (concentrated bursts of model feature rollouts across providers). Combine these to produce a Provider Volatility Index and an alerting surface for Product, Sales, and Ops.

Why this matters: enables proactive pricing conversations with enterprise accounts, informs fallback strategy prioritization (which model variants to onboard first), and gives Sales/PMs early warning for contract renegotiation or migration risk mitigation.
acceptance_criteria: Ingest pipeline collects price and release metadata for top 12 providers and 8 open-model repositories on a daily cadence
Pricing Velocity metric computed and historicalized (7d, 30d, 90d windows) with documented algorithm
Release Surge metric computed from release cadence, feature tags, and Git/announcements clustering
Provider Volatility Index available in a dashboard with time-series, sortable table, and CSV export
Alert rules: P0 alert for >20% price delta week-over-week or simultaneous major feature releases across >=3 providers
Runbook describing triage steps, customer-facing messaging templates, and recommended fallback candidate list
tasks: Research sources: vendor pricing pages, official announcement feeds, GitHub releases, model zoo feeds, Twitter/X handles and RSS feeds (owner: Marcus)
Design data schema for price history and release events, including canonical provider/model identifiers (owner: Data Eng)
Build ETL: scrapers, API connectors, and deduplication heuristics; schedule daily ingestion (owner: Infra)
Implement Pricing Velocity algorithm and backfill 12 months of historical data for trend validation (owner: Analytics)
Dashboard: Redwood Console mock + lightweight internal Grafana prototype + CSV export (owner: DX)
Alerting: define thresholds, integrate with PagerDuty/Slack channels and create SLO for false-positive rate (owner: SRE)
Write runbook and sample customer comms; run tabletop with Sales/CS (owner: PM)
Stakeholder review and iteration: internal demo, security review, legal review for scraping (owner: PM)
Rollout to internal users; collect feedback for 3-week iteration loop
stakeholders: Head of Research: Dr. Emil Novak
deliverables: Daily ingestion pipeline for pricing & releases
Pricing Velocity and Release Surge algorithms with 1-year backfill
Provider Volatility Index dashboard and CSV export
Executive one-pager and Sales talking points
